baselineProvenance.description: Lossless snapshot of retained employer exports from the supplied pssdb build. Original CSV files were not committed. Not an independently verified official disclosure. Per-row original agency spelling cannot be recovered; employer aliases are preserved.

limitations: The original PDF explicitly covers the year ended March 31, 2022; the compiled label remains 2020/21. Neither dataset is silently redated.
Financial tuple groups retain occurrence counts and nulls. Shared amounts do not establish an identity, and ambiguous groups are not assigned one-to-one.
Titles are published in the official schedule, while the compiled 2020/21 cohort has no positions. Financial overlap does not establish full field equality.
Twelve financial occurrences on each side are unmatched. No compiled observation is removed or overwritten by this import.
